# Andry Huang — Senior Full-Stack & AI Developer

> Senior Full-Stack & AI Systems Engineer based in Surabaya, Indonesia with 7+ years of continuous experience (since September 2019) building enterprise SaaS platforms, AI recruitment tools, POS systems, and cloud architectures.

- AI & Automation: Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude 3.7, AI Agents
- Database & Cloud: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Docker, Redis, Azure, AWS

## Experience & Projects
- Founder & Lead Architect at Qualiv (AI-powered Recruitment Platform)
- Senior Full-Stack Developer at MRI Software (Enterprise SaaS & SMRT Tenant Management)
- Built multi-tenant POS systems (RFID Gold, Tire ERP), HR portals, and database migration tools.
